chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم prayed al-ẓuhr and al-ʿaṣr with the people when the sun had declined, in congregation, without any cause; and he prayed al-maghrib and al-ʿishāʾ al-ākhirah with them before the twilight disappeared, without any cause, in congregation. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم only did that so that the time would be expansive for his Ummah.

key_terms.لِيَتَّسِعَ الْوَقْتُ: so that the time would be broadened and made easier
key_terms.مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلَّةٍ: without any special cause or excuse

ai.seo_question: Does this hadith show that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم combined prayers without an excuse?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم combined al-ẓuhr with al-ʿaṣr and al-maghrib with al-ʿishāʾ in congregation without any special excuse. It indicates a juristic basis for the permissibility of combining these prayers in order to create ease and spaciousness for the Ummah.
